title: Zero-fold Tate tower comparison with the canonical scalar unit
statement: For a Noetherian scheme T and prime ell invertible on T, let d be natural, M an AdicTower, e its finite twist identifications and h its equality to strictDerivedTower, all as in [def-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower-data] and [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Assume ProjectionNormalized, the scalarComparison/proTwistMap square at every comparable pair for every normalized CoefficientLineComparison, and existence of those comparisons. If d=0, replacing each e_n by e_n followed by the specified finiteZeroIso gives the corresponding square with the canonical unitReduction. This asserts only the zero-exponent unit clause for an already given tower.

source.place: Zero-fold tensor clause of the normalized Tate tower argument

proof.text: For the zero tensor exponent, expand CoefficientLineComparison.tensorPower: it is scalarZeroLineIso, hence the canonical scalar unit comparison conjugated by the etale single-unit maps. Expand finiteZeroIso and unitReduction. Cancel the site-comparison unit isomorphisms and use naturality of pbcComparisonReduction at the single-unit isomorphism to obtain proScalar.map(finiteZeroIso_b) followed by unitReduction = proTwistMap_0 followed by finiteZeroIso_a. Choose the normalized root comparison supplied in the first step. Apply derivedRealization to this equation and use naturality of scalarComparison at finiteZeroIso_b. Compose its normalization square with derivedRealization.map(finiteZeroIso_a). This is exactly the required zero-degree square for e_0, including equal indices. Assemble the witnesses and all clauses.

proof_origin.place: Naturality calculation for the canonical scalar unit at zero tensor power

from.place: Step 2: realize the normalized Tate-unit system with common bounds and stratification

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedTateTensorTower_zero
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (M : AdicTower T (datum.{u} ell))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, M.level n ≅
      (derivedRealization T ell n).obj (finiteTwist T ell n d))
    (h : M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d)
    (hp : ProjectionNormalized T ell hT d M e h)
    (hsquare : ∀ (b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
      (r : CoefficientLineComparison
        (FiniteReduction.quotient.{u} ell (Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1))
        (ell ^ (b + 1)) (ell ^ (a + 1))
        (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T),
      (pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T (datum.{u} ell) b a hab)).map (e b).hom ≫
          (scalarComparison T ell b a hab).hom.app (finiteTwist T ell b d) ≫
          (derivedRealization T ell a).map (proTwistMap d r) =
        (M.normalization b a hab).hom ≫ (e a).hom)
    (hcomparisons : ∀ (b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b), Nonempty
      (CoefficientLineComparison
        (FiniteReduction.quotient.{u} ell (Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1))
        (ell ^ (b + 1)) (ell ^ (a + 1))
        (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T)) :
    ∀ hd : d = 0, ∀ (b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b),
      let e₀ (n : ℕ) := e n ≪≫ (derivedRealization T ell n).mapIso
        (eqToIso (congrArg (finiteTwist T ell n) hd) ≪≫ finiteZeroIso T ell n);
      (pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T (datum.{u} ell) b a hab)).map (e₀ b).hom ≫
          (scalarComparison T ell b a hab).hom.app (𝟙_ _) ≫
          (derivedRealization T ell a).map (unitReduction T ell b a hab).hom =
        (M.normalization b a hab).hom ≫ (e₀ a).hom
